summary: Plague Inc. entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Plague Inc.
entries.definitive_edition: Current official mobile build for the original route; Evolved as separate comparison

emulation.notes: Use real touch hardware for mobile route where possible.

primary.why: Plague Inc. began as a mobile strategy/simulation game, so the current official iOS/Android app is the main route for the original entry. Plague Inc: Evolved is a PC/console remake/expanded route and should be documented separately as a variant.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official mobile app. Record device, app version, premium/IAP state, scenario pack ownership, The Cure availability, difficulty, pathogen/scenario, and whether Evolved was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Expanded remake route with PC/console interface and multiplayer support
secondary.what_to_play: Use if desktop capture or Evolved-specific modes matter.
secondary.why: It is a related expanded version, not the original mobile artifact.

all_releases.reason: primary: target artifact for the queue entry.

all_releases.platform: Plague Inc: Evolved on Windows / consoles
all_releases.reason: secondary: use for Evolved-specific features or capture.
